items.title: New savings tax brackets: why your deposits pay more
items.body: Spain's IRPF (income tax) on savings now has progressive brackets from 19% on gains up to €6,000 up to 30% over €300,000. This applies to interest from deposits, accounts, and Letras del Tesoro (Treasury bills), taxed separately from salary. Many investors are only now realizing the higher rates.

items.title: Andalusia estimates €500M hit from cancelled state rental registry
items.body: The annulled state registry of short-term rentals has cost Andalusia over €500 million in administrative costs and lost profits, according to the regional government. The Supreme Court ruled the state lacked competence, siding with Andalusia, Valencia, Canarias, and Murcia.

items.title: Spain lowers medicine co-payments for middle and low-income patients
items.body: A new Royal Decree Law effective May 14 reduces the pharmaceutical co-payment for workers with medium and low incomes, especially benefiting chronic and multi-medicated patients. The change modifies the percentage paid based on income and employment status.

items.title: Spain negotiates to avoid diesel tax increase amid Iran war
items.body: The government is trying to convince the European Commission to unblock €475 million in frozen Next Generation EU funds by waiving a required diesel tax hike, now politically impossible due to soaring oil prices from the Iran conflict. The fiscal reform originally promised the increase.

items.title: Solar boom causes grid instability, Red Eléctrica demands 600M fix
items.body: Six years of uncontrolled solar panel expansion have destabilized Spain's electricity grid, forcing operator Red Eléctrica to request an emergency €600 million investment to compensate for severe oscillations, especially in Andalusia, Extremadura, and Castilla-La Mancha.

items.title: Zapatero at center of Plus Ultra corruption network, police say
items.body: Former Prime Minister Zapatero has been imputed as the strategic supervisor of a €53 million rescue of Plus Ultra airline during the pandemic. Police reports describe a web of influence peddling, shell companies, and false invoices orchestrated to secure the public aid.

items.title: Israel summons Spanish charge d'affaires over police action against flotilla activists
items.body: Israel demanded explanations from Spain after the Ertzaintza (Basque police) charged activists returning from a Gaza flotilla in Bilbao. Israel accused Spain of hypocrisy for condemning Israel while remaining silent on the incident.

items.title: EU and UK urge Iran and US to formalize ceasefire agreement
items.body: European Commission President von der Leyen and UK officials have called on Iran and the United States to sign a principles agreement paving the way for an indefinite ceasefire. This follows predictions from Trump and Rubio that the deal was imminent.
